entries.00a4df242b1647d3: This is a single-segment business that provides listed companies and issuers of financial instruments with integrated practical support for statutory disclosure and IR. The group consists of the company and 16 consolidated subsidiaries, and consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥32,821 million. It combines consulting and outsourcing by specialists, IT services such as disclosure document preparation support systems, and content production services such as Web production, translation, video production, data processing and printing. The services handled are divided into 4 categories: listed company disclosure-related, listed company IR and event-related, financial instrument disclosure-related, and database-related.
